gatoh.graphs.graphs.GraphSet

class GraphSet(model: Any, graphs: list[Graph] | None = None)[source]

A class that will collect all of the different social hierarchy graphs in the same structure and provide utilities using this collection.

Parameters:

  • model (ABModel) – The parent model that this GraphSet is being attached to.

  • graphs (list[Graph], optional) – Existing Graph objects that should be added to the GraphSet.

__init__(model: Any, graphs: list[Graph] | None = None) → None[source]

Loads a GraphSet that has been saved following the same process as in the save_graphset() function.
